summary: Page 1 and Page 2 match the official April 2024 ENCS layout closely; small print tweaks needed (Item 26 label extra space, Item 52 caption touching bottom border), while comb-tick collisions, left-aligned schedule amounts, and a misattached screen validation error on Item 37 need shared changes.

defects.where: Page 1 Items 9, 10, 14A and Page 2 Taxpayer's Last Name/Registered Name
defects.what: Long registered name, address, and Item 14A specify text switch out of comb mode and collide with comb ticks.
Numeric amounts in Schedule 1 (Cols D-I), Schedule 2, Schedule 3 (Cols C-D), and Schedule 4 (Col E) are left-aligned flush against the left cell border.
Label reads 'TOTAL AMOUNT PAYABLE/( Excess Credits)' with an unintended space after '(' vs official 'TOTAL AMOUNT PAYABLE/(Excess Credits)'.
Second line '(From Part V Schedule 1, Column I)' touches the bottom cell border.

defects.where: Part IV Item 37 (Total Adjusted Output Tax Due)
defects.what: Computed read-only numeric Item 37 displays 'Use at most 50 characters.' repeated three times (misattached length errors from other text fields).

defects.where: Part V Schedules (Schedule 1 and Schedule 3 headers)
defects.what: Header shows '12 rows' on the right while the body says 'No rows yet.' with '+ Add row', which is contradictory (shows capacity instead of current row count).

shared_changes_wanted: neon-4 (try/forms-shared-print): comb-tick collisions on long name/address/14A; left-aligned amounts in Part V Schedules 1-4
crates/bir-app-api or nsh/screens/form/: misattached 'Use at most 50 characters.' errors on read-only Item 37; contradictory '12 rows' vs 'No rows yet.' badge on empty growable schedules
